name: route_aalopro_action
description: Classify one AaloPro user request. Use open_curriculum only when the user asks to open or study a class/subject; start_quiz for a quiz; explain_again for a simpler repeat of the current answer; parent_guide or teacher_guide for adult guidance; save_note only when explicitly asked to save text; general_online for an open knowledge question. Copy only values stated by the user.
